note: apply_review_verdicts.py --book-reviews: each decision a person made in the review tool, as the stamp of the question it decided
figures_note: each decision a person made on an S4 figure (Generated content → Figures), with the visuals it shows as; the visuals table has no review columns, so apply_review_verdicts.py lists these and writes none
generated_note: each decision a person made on a generated misconception or widget mapping (Generated content); neither has review columns, so these are listed and none is written: a rejected one, or one a fix was asked for, is left out of the compiled files
